XenotypeDef.label: basilisk
XenotypeDef.description: A venomous hunter of caves and deserts. Her strikes pass a slowing venom into her prey, pinning it helpless long before she closes in to finish it - alive, always alive, for what use is a dead mate to a basilisk? Her heavy serpent tail slows her down; her venom makes certain the prey comes to her.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A cave and desert hunter whose venom-laced strikes slow her prey to a standstill.

XenotypeDef.label: lamia
XenotypeDef.description: A serpent-tailed mamono of the high caves and mountains. Silver-tongued, she talks her way out of trouble as easily as she coils her way into it - and when words fail, her tail drags the unwary into a teasing embrace.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A persuasive serpent-tailed mamono who grapples foes with her powerful tail.

XenotypeDef.label: medusa
XenotypeDef.description: A rarer and stranger cousin of the lamia, dwelling among cold stones and forgotten ruins. Her gaze can freeze a victim solid - alive but motionless, hunger and weariness held in perfect stasis - until the spell loosens days later.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A rare lamia-kin whose petrifying gaze freezes a victim in place for days.

XenotypeDef.label: wurm
XenotypeDef.description: A huge, blunt-bodied tunneller of the deep caves and wet places. Immensely strong and almost comically dim, she solves every problem the same way - by hitting it until it stops being a problem. Her claws are famously sharp, and her thick serpent tail can crush the fight out of anyone she coils around.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A colossal, dim-witted tunneller with crushing strength, sharp claws, and a heavy serpent tail.

XenotypeDef.label: dragon
XenotypeDef.description: A great winged queen of the mountain keeps, wreathed in fire she cannot feel. Every dragon is a hoard-keeper - proud, avaricious, and utterly certain of her own magnificence. Do not touch her gold. Do not touch her mate.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A winged, fire-wreathed hoard-keeper: arrogant, greedy, and terribly proud.

XenotypeDef.label: lizardman
XenotypeDef.description: A peerless blade-fighter of the caves. Quick to anger and quicker with a sword, a lizardman lives for the clean clash of the melee and answers every insult with steel. Mercenary companies of the mountains prize them - and fear them.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: An aggressive cave-dwelling swordmaster who lives for close combat.

XenotypeDef.label: wyvern
XenotypeDef.description: A swift cousin of the dragon, leaner and quicker on the wing but without her great strength - or her insufferable pride. Wyverns hunt the high crags in shrieking flocks, claws first, questions never.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A fast-flying dragon cousin: weaker than a dragon, but swift and sharp-clawed.

XenotypeDef.label: malef dragon
XenotypeDef.description: A dark, corrupted dragon of terrible beauty. Lust is her weapon: her teasing touch unravels the strongest will, and the women she claims wake remade - baselines rising as dragonewts, dragons blackened into malef mirrors of herself.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A corrupted dragon whose teasing touch transforms her female victims.

XenotypeDef.label: dragonewt
XenotypeDef.description: What a woman becomes under a malef dragon's touch: a lesser dragon-kin, flushed with new scales and a hunger she never asked for. Dragonewts are as teasing and as lustful as the dark queens who made them - but the change ends with them.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A dragon-kin remade by a malef dragon: teasing, lustful, and newly scaled.

XenotypeDef.label: salamander
XenotypeDef.description: A fire-kissed breed of lizardman born in volcanic caves and rivers of cooling lava. Flame is her element and her birthright; she bathes in heat that would kill a baseline woman and calls it a pleasant warmth.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A volcanic lizardman-kin, wholly at home in fire and lava.

XenotypeDef.label: bunyip
XenotypeDef.description: A brutish, swamp-dwelling cousin of the lamia who haunts rivers and still lakes. Strong as an ox and about as talkative - a bunyip would sooner drag you under with her claws than waste breath on a greeting.
XenotypeDef.descriptionShort: A strong, sharp-clawed, hopeless-talker lamia-kin of rivers and lakes.
